steps.title: Prepare 5× BRB80 buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL of 5× BRB80 by dissolving 6.06 g PIPES (400 mM) in water, add solid KOH (~1.35 g) to dissolve PIPES, then add 0.5 mL 0.5 M EGTA (5 mM) and 0.25 mL 1 M MgCl₂ (5 mM); adjust pH to 6.8 only with KOH, filter through a 0.22 µm filter, store up to 4 weeks at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare working solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the 5× BRB80 10‑fold on the day of use to obtain 1× BRB80 and keep on ice. Aliquot PLL‑PEG to 2 mg/mL in water and store at –20 °C. Prepare β‑casein 25 mg/mL in 1× BRB80, ultracentrifuge, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C. Prepare ATP 100 mM, pH 7, filter, aliquot and store at –80 °C. Freshly make gliding buffer by mixing 1× BRB80 with 5 mM β‑ME, 1 mM ATP and 1 mg/mL β‑casein; keep at room temperature on the day of the assay.

steps.title: Polymerize dim GMPCPP seeds
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen unlabeled tubulin, fluorescent tubulin (AlexaFluor647 or Atto647) and optional biotinylated tubulin on ice. In a microcentrifuge tube combine to a final concentration of 3 µM total tubulin in 1× BRB80, add 0.5 mM GMPCPP, include fluorescent tubulin at 3‑5 % labeling ratio and, if desired, 18 % biotinylated tubulin; bring volume to 200 µL. Incubate on ice 5 min, then transfer to 37 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Pellet and wash dim seeds
steps.instruction: Warm 3 mL of 1× BRB80 to 37 °C. After polymerization, add 170 µL warm 1× BRB80 to the reaction, centrifuge at 17 000×g for 10 min at room temperature, discard supernatant. Wash the pellet with 400 µL warm 1× BRB80, centrifuge again 17 000×g for 10 min RT, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 50 µL warm 1× BRB80. Keep the dim seeds at room temperature.

steps.title: Dilute DARPin (D1)₂
steps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot of DARPin (D1)₂ and dilute on ice with 1× BRB80 to a working concentration of 2.5 µM.

steps.title: Prepare bright tubulin mixture
steps.instruction: From fresh tubulin aliquots prepare a second 200 µL mixture containing 3 µM total tubulin in 1× BRB80, 0.5 mM GMPCPP, fluorescent tubulin at a 10‑15 % labeling ratio and optional 18 % biotinylated tubulin. Incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Cap plus ends and extend
steps.instruction: While the bright mixture is on ice, add 2 µL of the 2.5 µM DARPin (D1)₂ dilution to 8 µL of the dim seed suspension at room temperature to cap plus ends. Dilute the bright mixture with 200 µL cold 1× BRB80, then transfer 90 µL of this diluted bright mixture to 37 °C and incubate 1 min. Add the 10 µL DARPin‑capped dim‑seed mixture directly to the warmed bright mixture (final concentrations: 50 nM DARPin (D1)₂, 1.35 µM tubulin, 0.23 mM GMPCPP). Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h to allow bright extensions to grow from the minus ends.

steps.title: Pellet and wash marked microtubules
steps.instruction: Dilute the reaction with 170 µL warm 1× BRB80, centrifuge at 17 000×g for 10 min at room temperature, discard supernatant (contains unpolymerized tubulin, GMPCPP and excess DARPin). Wash the pellet with 400 µL warm 1× BRB80, centrifuge again 17 000×g for 10 min RT, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 50 µL warm 1× BRB80. Keep at room temperature and use the polarity‑marked microtubules the same day.

steps.title: Check labeling by fluorescence
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:6 dilution of the microtubules (1 µL sample + 5 µL buffer), place a drop between a #1.5 coverslip and a microscope slide, gently squash, and image with a fluorescence microscope. Verify that each filament shows a dim seed segment and a single bright extension.

steps.title: Assemble gliding assay chamber
steps.instruction: Place two strips of double‑sided adhesive tape on a standard microscope slide about 5 mm apart, press firmly with forceps or a tube end, leave the protective backing on and let sit ≥15 min at room temperature. Pipette 10 µL of 2 mg/mL PLL‑PEG between the strips, spread to the edges, allow to dry, then rinse thoroughly with Milli‑Q water and dry with pressurized air. Cut a #1.5 22 × 22 mm coverslip into four equal squares with a diamond scribe, remove debris with air. Remove the tape backing and place one coverslip square onto the taped area, pressing firmly to ensure adhesion.

steps.title: Load motor and image gliding
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL gliding buffer to the chamber, pull through with filter paper and incubate 3 min at room temperature. Dilute the minus‑end‑directed motor (e.g., HSET) to 100 nM in gliding buffer, flow 50 µL through the chamber, incubate 3 min RT. Dilute the polarity‑marked seeds 1:6 with room‑temperature gliding buffer, flow 50 µL into the chamber and pull through. Seal both ends of the chamber with Korasilon™ paste. Image the fluorescent microtubules on a spinning‑disk confocal microscope using a 5 s frame interval for a total of 20 min; seeds should glide with the dim (plus) end leading for a minus‑end‑directed motor, confirming correct polarity labeling.
